name: tNavigator SCHEDULE Simulator Check Adapter — async IT runner boundary
description: Portable SUBMIT/STATUS/CANCEL/RESULT boundary for an external sandboxed tNavigator 22.2 runner.

parameters.content:
## IT-managed tNavigator 22.2 check boundary

This workflow never executes shell or reads server files. Configure the runner URL and logical check profile in the Set node, then select an HTTP Header Auth credential. The runner resolves immutable artifact refs inside its sandbox. Supported actions: SUBMIT, STATUS, CANCEL, RESULT. Raw host paths/commands/full logs must never be returned.
